subject: Xcode 5.0.2 and version of clang++ and g++

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Xcode 5.0.2 and version of clang++ and g++
parts:
Xcode 5.0.2 is out.

Has anyone else installed it, and if so, could you verify
that the versions of clang++ and g++ did not change?

Online, people seem to be reporting the same versions of g++
and clang++ in versions 5.0.1 and 5.0.2.

The Wikipedia has good detail, but stops at 5.0.0:

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xcode

I get this with my current install:

~$ clang++ -v
Apple LLVM version 5.0 (clang-500.2.79) (based on LLVM 3.3svn)
Target: x86_64-apple-darwin13.0.0
Thread model: posix

~$ g++ -v
Configured with: --prefix=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr --with-gxx-include-dir=/usr/include/c++/4.2.1
Apple LLVM version 5.0 (clang-500.2.79) (based on LLVM 3.3svn)
Target: x86_64-apple-darwin13.0.0
Thread model: posix

- Bob
